title: Intent-anchored profile merger and staged changelog sifter
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary: introduce an intent-aware profile merger that consolidates incoming model performance profiles while preserving workload-specific signals (chat, completion, embeddings, reranking). Add a staged changelog sifter that ranks suggested release notes by estimated customer impact and signal provenance so release drafts are concise and prioritised.

Motivation: onboarding spikes frequently carry redundant or conflicting profile entries when the same model is ingested from multiple sources (community uploads, model zoo mirrors, vendor bundles). Naive merges collapse metrics and lose workload-specific tails (e.g. long-chat latency vs short-completion p50). This causes regressions for customers who rely on per-intent profiles. The changelog authoring process also floods release notes with low-importance deltas; we need a lightweight ranking to surface high-impact items.

What this PR changes:
- Add an intent-anchor data model (profile.intent_tags and profile.anchor_fingerprint) and merger logic that performs a two-phase merge: 1) intent stratification to group subprofiles by intent vectors, 2) anchor-preserving aggregation that keeps representative exemplars for each intent and computes merged distributional stats (p10/p50/p90, tokenized latency histograms).
- Implement a staged changelog sifter service which consumes profile deltas and emits ranked changelog fragments with provenance (source repo, onboarding agent, telemetry sample size). The sifter uses heuristics: weight by relative regression magnitude, sample volume, user-visible metric (e.g. quality drop on canonical prompt sets), and per-intent footprint.
- Introduce a lightweight provenance token (profile.provenance_token) used by the console to trace release snippets back to source commits and telemetry slices.
- Add migration path: an on-disk transformer that detects legacy profile documents and backfills intent tags using a heuristic classifier based on prompt distribution hash.

Checklist: 
- [x] Intent-anchor model and schema changes
- [x] Merger algorithm + unit tests
- [x] Changelog sifter + integration tests
- [x] Migration transformer and data-sanity checks
- [x] Console slice to show provenance token and ranked changelog preview
- [x] Docs: registry onboarding guide + changelog authoring notes

Commits (high-level):
- Add intent anchor schema and migration helper
- Implement two-phase merger (intent stratify + anchor-preserve agg)
- Changelog sifter service and ranking heuristics
- Console UI hook for provenance token and ranked preview
- Tests: unit + integration + e2e for representative scenarios

Files changed (high level):
- src/registry/schema/profile.ts -> adds intent_tags, anchor_fingerprint, provenance_token
- src/registry/merger/intent_merger.py -> core algorithm (new)
- src/registry/changelog/sifter_service.go -> ranking and output formatter (new)
- migrations/2026-02-intent-backfill.py -> legacy profile detector/backfiller
- web/console/src/components/ChangelogPreview.tsx -> UI hook for ranked preview
- docs/registry/onboarding.md -> docs + examples

Testing and CI: all unit and integration tests were run in CI. Initial CI run failed on a flaky e2e (console snapshot mismatch) — fixed by updating stable snapshot generation; rerun passed. CI summary: build & unit tests passed, integration tests passed, e2e passed on rerun.

Backward compatibility: the schema change is additive. Migration included; operator-run migration recommended for large registries. No breaking API changes expected for consumers of profile read endpoints.

Related Linear/JIRA: Linear: ENG-4823, ENG-5631, PM-211
Related PRs: small console tweak PR #547981 (console preview styles)

Merge: squash and merge. Merge commit includes the migration script and a short runbook note for operators.

Notes for reviewers: focus on intent stratification heuristics in intent_merger.py and the ranking weights in sifter_service.go — both are intentionally conservative and parameterized for rollout. The migration backfill is purposely non-destructive (writes into profile.intent_tags only when confidence > 0.85).

review_comments: Liam O'Connor (reviewer): The stratification looks good but we should guard the p90 merge when sample_count < 100 to avoid noisy spikes.
Ava Martinez (author): Good catch — added a min_sample_count parameter (default 100) and a fallback to median-based imputation when sample_count is low.
Priya Shah (reviewer): Can the provenance_token be translated to a console deep link? Would help debugging.
Ava Martinez (author): Yes — added a console route /profiles/:id/provenance that maps token -> telemetry slice. Added unit tests for the link resolver.
Marco Rossi (reviewer): The changelog ranking weights need an opt-out; SRE may not want automated notes surfaced for infra-only deltas.
Ava Martinez (author): Added a allowlist and an opt-out label (changelog:manual) so infra-only deltas are filtered from automatic suggestions.
notes_for_ops: Run migrations/2026-02-intent-backfill.py in dry-run mode first and validate a sample of profiles for accuracy. For registries >10M profiles, run backfill on a rolling window and monitor profile-read latency during migration.
